name: Indian Navy Agniveer (SSR and MR)
summary: Four-year enrolment in the Navy as an Agniveer: Senior Secondary Recruit (SSR, Class 12 science) or Matric Recruit (MR, Class 10). Same Agnipath package as the Army: Rs 30,000 a month in year one.

status.note: One notice usually covers two batches. For 01/2027 and 02/2027, applications ran from 14 March to 6 April 2026, with the online test (INET) in May 2026.

posts.name: Agniveer (SSR)
posts.responsibilities: Sailor in seamanship, engineering, electrical and other trades.
posts.notes: Class 12 with Maths and Physics plus Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science (50%).

age.summary: 17.5 to 21 years on the enrolment date (birth-date windows are set per batch).

education.summary: SSR: Class 12 with Maths and Physics and one of Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science, 50% overall. MR: Class 10 with 50%.

eligibility.physical: Physical fitness test and Navy medical standards.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

stages.name: Physical fitness test and recruitment medical
Final medical at the training establishment

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from the online test among those who pass the fitness and medical tests.

salary.officialGrossNote: First-year package Rs 30,000 a month: Rs 21,000 in hand and Rs 9,000 to the Agniveer Corpus Fund, matched by the government.
salary.pension: No pension or gratuity. Seva Nidhi of about Rs 11.71 lakh (tax free) after four years.
salary.notes: Life insurance of Rs 48 lakh during service.

progression.post: Regular cadre (up to 25% of each batch)

career.promotionNotes: Retention depends on performance during the four years.

benefits.detail: Rs 48 lakh life insurance during service; about Rs 11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi at exit.

workLife.nature: Sailor duties at sea and ashore.
workLife.stability: Fixed four-year term; regular cadre only for up to 25%.

difficulty.rationale: School-level test, but many applicants and strict fitness standards.

ratings.rationale: Two batches a year, but only four years unless retained.
